children: Tongcheng Travel's 4Q outlook disappoints UOB Kay Hian analysts, leading the brokerage to downgrade its rating on the stock to hold from buy. While the Chinese online travel company's 3Q results were largely in line with estimates, it guided for revenue to remain flat or decline 5% year over year in 4Q, the analysts say in a note. The company expects its adjusted net profit at 450 million-500 million yuan, reflecting pressure on railway ticketing after new restrictions, they add. The analysts cut their 2026 revenue and adjusted profit projections by 1.6% and 8.1%, respectively, to reflect the weaker guidance. UOB KH also cuts its target price to 10.00 Hong Kong dollars from HK$18.00. Shares rise 0.1% to HK$8.12. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
